integrity.computational_method: exact integer modular inverses and Apéry shortest paths
integrity.mathematical_claim: S_n is symmetric exactly for n in {2,3,6,7,8,18}; Frobenius/genus values in RESULT.md are corollaries.
proof_dependencies: Finite exact residue certificates stated in RESULT.md and replayed by verify.py

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordinary three-consecutive-hexagonal triples with n>=2 only. The universal part relies on the classical three-generator gluing criterion and the displayed arithmetic inequalities. The finite residue table has been exactly checked; an equivalent specialization may exist in unlocated literature.
title: Symmetry classification for semigroups of consecutive ordinary hexagonal numbers
